approval_ref: The user explicitly requested implementation of relational file context in model input.
notes: Reuse saved document, page, locator and storage-order metadata rather than adding a graph database or semantic relation model.
Keep exact source text in the existing evidence aliases and make source_groups navigation-only metadata.
Deduplicate repeated file and locator metadata so the new input is smaller on every frozen fixed-15 question.
Do not make a provider call until offline structure and input-size gates pass.
title: Add a compact deterministic relation pack to QA V3 input
acceptance_tests: Every admitted evidence alias occurs exactly once in one source group and retains its exact source text
Groups expose deterministic file, page, locator scope and original source order without copying source text
File names and locators are shared by source_groups instead of repeated on every provider-facing evidence item
The fixed-15 zero-call measurement is smaller for every question than the prior flat input metadata shape
objective: Expose useful file and source relationships to QA V3 with less repeated input and no new semantic inference.
